summary.intent: Plan, verify, and execute phase 64 (Rotation Soundness — Revocation Guarantees) of CipherBox, then ship it via /ship-phase 64.
summary.outcome: Planning completed successfully after 2 verification iterations (1 blocker + 2 warnings found and fixed), producing 8 plans across 6 waves. Execution was initiated with Wave 1 plan 64-01 dispatched; the transcript ends mid-execution before /ship-phase 64 ran.

repo: D-02 bug: `sealChildReadKey` in engine.ts L344-350 seals under the child's own pre-rotation key (legacy `parentReadKey` misnomer). The correct re-seal belongs out-of-band in `rotateReadFromNode` (BFS caller) under the parent's NEW readKey', not inside `rotateOne`.

D-06 bug: `registration.ts` L174-175 uses `params.nodeId ?? crypto.randomUUID()` and `params.nodeGeneration ?? 0`, silently breaking AAD stability across all 6 `updateFolderMetadataAndPublish` call sites in client.ts that omit these params.

D-07 bug: Two ordering bugs in engine.ts — `completedNodeIds.add` at L386 fires before `reMintGrantsRootedAt` at L391 (must swap); resume guard at L458-462 short-circuits without calling `verifySubtreeClean` (must rebuild frontier from IPNS truth).
`mergeChildren` in `folder/merge.ts` is a Phase-64 stub — researcher found it as a bonus beyond the four seams named in the design.
Fresh worktrees in this monorepo lack node_modules, making typecheck/tests fail without a multi-minute `pnpm i`; sequential execution on the main tree is the correct GSD executor mode here.
Wave 6 (64-08 sdk-e2e) requires live docker stack (ipfs, postgres, redis:6380) plus API dev server on port 3000 — must be started before execution begins to allow warm-up time.
GSD plan-checker enforces that RESEARCH.md `## Open Questions` must be renamed to `## Open Questions (RESOLVED)` with inline markers before execution can proceed — this is a hard blocker gate.
GSD commit helper JSON output reports `commit_failed` even on successful commits (known false-negative); must verify via `git log --oneline -1` to confirm actual outcome.

code.finding: sealChildReadKey uses `parentReadKey` which is actually the child's own pre-rotation key (misnomer). Out-of-band re-seal under parent's NEW readKey' must happen in the BFS caller rotateReadFromNode, not here.
completedNodeIds.add fires here, BEFORE reMintGrantsRootedAt at L391. Must be swapped — node should only be marked complete after re-minting succeeds.
Resume guard short-circuits the walk without calling verifySubtreeClean. Must rebuild frontier from published IPNS truth (D-10) instead of returning early.
Four named throwing stubs (mintFileKeyOnRotate, reMintGrantsRootedAt, mergeConcurrentChildren, verifySubtreeClean) — signatures frozen, bodies are Phase 64's primary deliverable.

id: params.nodeId ?? crypto.randomUUID() and generation: params.nodeGeneration ?? 0 silently break AAD stability. All 6 client.ts call sites omit these params; D-06 fix requires threading explicit nodeId/nodeGeneration through FolderState.

Canonical sdk-e2e scaffold template — same imports, sealNode + addToIpfs + createAndPublishIpnsRecord(sequenceNumber: 1n) pattern, 120s timeout. Plan 64-08 extends this pattern for depth ≥ 2 + fault-injection + resume assertions.

workflow: Concurrent background git operations race on the index — 'could not write index' is a transient plumbing error, not data loss. Wait for background subagents to finish before retrying commits.
plan-phase does not auto-commit PATTERNS.md; orchestrator must stage and commit it alongside VALIDATION.md after the pattern-mapper subagent returns.

VALIDATION.md is written as a skeleton (TBD per-task map, status: draft) by the orchestrator at §5.5; it must be filled from RESEARCH.md Validation Architecture table and set to status: final / nyquist_compliant: true before the plan-checker passes.
API-SURFACE.md regenerated with 0 symbols for this phase (pure SDK TypeScript, no schema changes) — skip it from planner reading list; RESEARCH.md + PATTERNS.md carry far richer detail.
Start long-running prereqs (API dev server, docker services) before execution begins — wave 6 e2e needs them warm, and they take time to boot.
Non-blocking drift gate firing on top-level config/repo files (unrelated to phase scope) is safe to ignore and continue — it is a stale-baseline artifact, not a real drift signal.

friction: Git index race: concurrent pattern-mapper subagent and VALIDATION.md commit caused 'could not write index' plumbing error, requiring a retry after the subagent finished.
GSD commit helper false-negative: JSON output reported commit_failed even though lint-staged + commit succeeded; required `git log` verification every time.

Plan-checker blocker on RESEARCH.md: open questions not marked (RESOLVED) was a one-line doc fix but triggered a full revision loop (re-spawn planner for 64-07 warning + doc edits + re-verify), adding ~15 min to planning.

VALIDATION.md TBD skeleton: the template writes a placeholder per-task map that the orchestrator must manually populate from RESEARCH.md — this is an easy-to-miss step that became a plan-checker warning.
